what: British American Tobacco sells cigarettes and smoke-free nicotine products in most of the world. Its brands include Dunhill, Lucky Strike and Pall Mall, and in smoke-free products Vuse vapes, Velo pouches and glo heated tobacco.
customers: Adult nicotine consumers worldwide, with the United States its single largest profit pool.
money: cigarettes sold under Dunhill, Lucky Strike, Pall Mall and Newport
Vuse vapour, Velo nicotine pouches and glo heated tobacco
traditional oral tobacco and wholesale operations
moat: Global brands and distribution in markets where advertising is restricted, which protects incumbents, plus scale in manufacturing.
risks: Cigarette volumes decline structurally in developed markets
It took a very large write-down on its US cigarette brands
Illegal vapes have taken share from Vuse in the US
Currency moves affect results because earnings come from many countries
opportunities: New Categories are approaching profitability after years of investment
Velo pouches are growing quickly in the US, the most profitable nicotine market
A dividend yield above 5% is covered by cash flow from the cigarette business
watch: New Category revenue and whether it keeps contributing profit rather than absorbing it.
